verdict.rationale: x402 is explicitly documented with SDK/CLI endpoints for both paying and charging (docs-12, docs-13, docs-27), and it's woven into agentic wallet tooling and MCP integration (docs-17, docs-18, docs-25). However, ACP, MPP, and AP2 are not mentioned anywhere in the evidence — only x402 is concretely supported. missing for 10: ACP support, MPP support, AP2 support, and any documented endpoints/SDKs for those protocols beyond x402.
